title: Cross-contract signature replay allows users to inflate rewards
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The signature verification in `NFTStaking._stakeNFTs()` does not include the contract address in the hash, allowing signatures to be replayed across the three different NFTStaking contracts (WORLDS_STAKING, GRAYBOYS_STAKING, AVATARS_STAKING).  ```solidity bytes32 hash = keccak256(abi.encode(_sender, _tokenIds, _rarityWeightIndexes)); ```  An attacker who owns the same token ID across different NFT collections can obtain a signature for a high-rarity NFT in one collection, then replay that signature when staking
